cache_policy.note: Fixed realistic suite; each prompt is sent once as a cold response. Do not average synthetic repeated prompts, warmed continuations, or n-gram/history-accelerated rows into this metric. Passing this artifact certifies only the performance workload; publication also requires a hash-bound independent quality/determinism attestation.

configuration.dtype: bfloat16 activations over the publisher FP8 block-128 weights

expert_host_placement.selection: experts never routed to in the A168 exact-2K trajectory census and the A197 realistic-suite census; placed in pinned host memory at load time behind a per-expert offset table in the Triton MoE kernel (USE_B_TABLE)

configuration.gdn_verifier_rows: the kernel extension's exact serial mode: VLLM_XPU_GDN_SERIAL_SPEC_DECODE=0, VLLM_XPU_GDN_NATIVE_SPEC_RECURRENT_SERIAL_EXACT=1, VLLM_XPU_GDN_SPEC_PERSISTENT_SCRATCH=1, VLLM_XPU_GDN_NATIVE_SPEC_COMPLETION_BARRIER=1, printed into the packet's derived launch source; the per-row decode kernel runs inside gdn_attention_spec_decode with the state passing through the BF16 cache between rows, as vLLM's Python serial path did
configuration.hc_triton: VLLM_XPU_HC_TRITON=1 printed into the packet's derived launch source: the Triton hyper-connection glue kernels (gate-mix, combine, combine-norm, silu) run on XPU instead of the torch fallbacks; MoE kernel, tuned map, offload and placement unchanged
configuration.offloaded_bytes_per_rank_expected: 12.22 GiB (PLE n-gram 11.92 + embeddings 0.30); every hot routed expert resident
configuration.qsa_fused_indexer: VLLM_XPU_QSA_FUSED_INDEXER=1 printed into the packet's derived launch source: the model's reference fused QSA pre-indexer replaces the unfused projection, norm, rope, group compression and cache stores; on the MTP1 head it is placed after the row-serial verify path so the multi-row verification step keeps its exactness
configuration.speculation: publisher MTP, one speculative token (lossless: every output pin equal to the MTP0 line)
configuration.tuned_config_key: logical expert count (placed layers are resident-sized; all three lookup sites key on _q38_num_experts)
